keyLimits.en: Fully free and open source with no feature restrictions; desktop only.

capabilities.en: Multi-track audio recording and non-destructive editing with real-time effects.
Built-in effects such as noise reduction, EQ, distortion, reverb and echo, plus spectrogram analysis.
Imports, exports and converts most common audio formats including MP3, M4A, AIFF, FLAC and WAV.
Supports VST3 and Nyquist plugins on all platforms, plus LV2 on Linux and Audio Units on macOS.
Optional cloud project backup and sharing via Audio.com.

limitations.en: Not a full digital audio workstation: no MIDI editing and no virtual instruments.
Desktop-only; no official mobile apps for iOS or Android.
Some audio format support (e.g. certain MP3 encoding) requires a separate FFmpeg library installation.

reason.en: Audio/video editor with transcript-based editing, competing for podcast and voice editing workflows.
AI-driven audio enhancement tool targeted at podcasters and voice recording cleanup.

unknowns: Exact Linux distribution compatibility beyond Ubuntu 22.04+ not detailed on the FAQ page consulted.
